business_problem: Liepin needed to identify where large models fit into recruiting workflows and then turn them into measurable gains in talent matching, interviewing, cost and hiring efficiency.
solution_summary: Liepin and Baidu AI Cloud focused their large-model work on talent selection, where structured evaluation and high manual effort create strong automation value. The resulting capability is Doris, an AI-driven interview product that combines Liepin's recruiting expertise with Baidu's large-model stack. Instead of only matching resumes to jobs, Doris evaluates candidates across more than one hundred dimensions from the iceberg model, runs eight kinds of tests in one process, supports customized interview creation in four steps and provides multilingual candidate interaction with a human-like experience. The system is designed to reduce the amount of manual work required from interviewers while making evaluation more standardized and scalable. In effect, Baidu's models become the intelligence layer for candidate screening, interview execution and report generation, while Liepin supplies the recruiting domain model, test logic and HR-service distribution network. That makes the product useful across enterprise hiring, probation evaluation, talent inventory and internal mobility workflows.
